conceptZh: 酸：左邊酉（酒罈），右邊夋；酸酸的檸檬和梅子從邊邊溜進來，玩具機器人嚐到酸得臉皺成一團。
object: a boxy toy robot built from mismatched parts with one long arm, a lemon that sneaks in from the edge, and a bowl of sour plum soup
morph: pieces of 酸 sneak in from the edges of the frame, dodge the robot's reach, and settle only after he grimaces at the sour taste
creativeAngle: 字的筆畫一塊一塊從畫面邊緣偷偷溜進來，躲著玩具機器人，等他嚐一口酸梅湯皺成一團，才乖乖落定。
promptEn: An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip on a solid pale cream-green backdrop. Cast: one boxy toy robot built from mismatched parts, a square teal body, a round head, one long arm and one short arm, and a small mischievous round lemon with a face. The only text on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 酸, drawn in saturated lime-green strokes with a slightly darker outline, ending centered, uncropped, about 70 percent of frame height with margins. 0.0-1.5s: the robot clanks in carrying a small steaming bowl of plum soup and a spoon, and a left-hand stroke piece peeks into the frame from the left edge, retreats the moment he turns his head, and a second piece peeks from the top. The first narrated 酸 lands as the robot sniffs the bowl and his eyes widen. 1.5-3.5s: the lemon rolls in from below and bumps the bowl; the robot sloshes the soup, reaches with his long arm to catch the piece peeking in from the right, which dodges up, then down, while the short arm flails at nothing; a third piece slides in behind him and tickles his antenna. The second narrated 酸 lands as the pieces finally slip together behind his back and click into the full strokes of 酸. 3.5-5.0s: the robot takes a big spoonful of plum soup; his whole face squishes, his eyes turn to spirals, his antenna curls, his short arm spins like a helicopter, and the lemon wobbles in sympathy with scrunched eyes. As the word 酸梅湯 is spoken a little round plum with a crinkly mouth bobs in the soup bowl and gives a tiny sour shiver. 5.0-8.0s: the glyph is perfectly still and clear for the last 3 seconds while the robot recovers, gives a thumbs-up with his long arm, and does a small shimmy next to the lemon on the side, away from the strokes. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, clear tones, no erhua, reading exactly these syllables: 酸、酸、酸梅湯 (ㄙㄨㄢ、ㄙㄨㄢ、ㄙㄨㄢ ㄇㄟˊ ㄊㄤ). The character twice with a short pause, then the word once, then stop. The word is audio only. No background music, no extra speech, no subtitles or flashing effects; stylized toys and cartoon fruit only, no real people.
